services.name: Online Shopping
services.description: Browse and purchase thousands of products across multiple categories including electronics, fashion, beauty, home appliances, groceries, and lifestyle items. Secure checkout, multiple payment options, and fast delivery available.

services.name: Order Management
services.description: Customers can view order history, track shipments in real time, cancel eligible orders, download invoices, and receive order status notifications via email and SMS.

services.name: Shipping & Delivery
services.description: Standard, express, and same-day delivery options available in select locations. Real-time tracking, estimated delivery dates, and delivery confirmation provided.

services.name: Returns & Refunds
services.description: Easy return process through the customer account dashboard. Eligible products can be returned within the return window for refunds, replacements, or store credit.

services.name: Customer Support
services.description: 24/7 customer support via live chat, email, and phone. Assistance with orders, payments, returns, refunds, product inquiries, and account issues.

services.name: Seller Marketplace
services.description: Third-party sellers can list and sell products on ShopVerse. Seller dashboard includes inventory management, order fulfillment tools, analytics, and payment settlement.

services.name: Gift Services
services.description: Gift wrapping, personalized gift messages, and direct shipping to recipients. Ideal for birthdays, holidays, and special occasions.

services.name: Subscription & Deals
services.description: Exclusive deals, flash sales, loyalty rewards, and subscription-based savings for frequent shoppers. Members receive early access to promotions.
